name: Breton Crêpes (Breton Galettes)
author: aeredren on based.cooking
steps: Mix flour, salt, egg and water. (In this order to avoid dry flour)
Let it rest one hour at room temperature.
Cook the galette on a crepe-maker or a big flat pan.
When garnishing, heat the galette again with a bit of salted butter.
Always keep the crepe-maker's T stick in water while cooking so the dough doesn't dry on it.
It will then be easier to spread the dough.

culture.text: A crêpe is a dish made from unleavened batter or dough that is cooked on a frying pan or a griddle. Crêpes are usually one of two varieties: sweet crêpes or savoury crêpes. They are often served with a wide variety of fillings such as cheese, fruit, vegetables, meats, and a variety of spreads. Crêpes can also be flambéed, such as in Crêpes Suzette.
